name: Soukoku no Tsuki ~Aoku Kagayaku Tsuki no Yoru ni...~
original_name: 蒼刻の月～蒼ク輝ク月ノ夜ニ・・・～
source:
Main character's parents die in a traffic accident, and he is invited to stay at his grandfather's place. One day girls arrive to live in the same mansion. Girls have the same circumstances as protagonist and, according to grandfather, are invited to live as protagonist's wife candidates.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母在一场交通事故中去世，他被邀请住在祖父家。有一天，女孩们来到同一栋豪宅居住。女孩们的境况与主角相同，据祖父所说，她们被邀请作为主角的妻子候选人生活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
